::: {.q-section}
::: {.lead}
Free electrons, atoms and photons are each powerful quantum systems on their own. Our lab studies what becomes possible when all three are controlled at the same time — from record-strength electron–light coupling, through electrons entangled with atomic media, to free-electron links between neutral-atom qubits.
